item.title: Photo Gallery: Northwest Ohio Peace Coalition Iran protest
item.description: Northwest Ohio’s leading peace and justice group called an emergency public demonstration against a looming U.S. military attack on Iran in Toledo on Feb. 1.

item.title: Pistons rout Nets 130-77 in most-lopsided victory in franchise history
item.description: DETROIT — Jalen Duren had 21 points and 10 rebounds after being added to the All-Star Game on Sunday night as an Eastern Conference reserve, and the Detroit Pistons routed the Brooklyn Nets 130-77 in the most-lopsided victory in franchise history.

item.title: From Elon Musk to the former Prince Andrew, a who’s who of powerful people named in Epstein files
item.description: NEW YORK — From tech titans to Wall Street power brokers and foreign dignitaries, a who’s who of powerful men make appearances in the huge trove of documents released by the Justice Department in connection with its investigations of Jeffrey Epstein.

item.title: Bad Bunny wins album of the year at the 2026 Grammy Awards, a first for a Spanish-language album
item.description: LOS ANGELES — Bad Bunny won album of the year at the 2026 Grammy Awards, closing out a surprising and history-making night. It is the first time a Spanish-language album has taken home the top prize.

item.title: Jarrett Allen scores career-high 40 points as the Cavaliers beat the Trail Blazers 130-111
item.description: PORTLAND, Ore. — Jarrett Allen scored a career-high 40 points and grabbed 17 rebounds as the Cleveland Cavaliers handed the Portland Trail Blazers their fifth straight loss with a 130-111 victory Sunday night.

item.title: Monday Memories: Treats could have kept this pet inside on Groundhog Day in 1980
item.description: After last week’s arctic deep freeze, Toledoans might be thinking about ways to manipulate local prognosticators' forecast for spring. The sweet siren call of a Tootsie Pop could be their secret weapon to lure a groundpig inside to stay. It may have been a Valentine's sweet in 1980, but Bill Whitt’s pet took its time savoring the candy.
